message: Ready to buy today. Heartland posts the T45 at $40,750 and warranty $2,325. Offering $33,500 for T45 + warranty.

Thanks for coming in ready to buy today. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but even their posted numbers add up to about $43,075 for the T45 and warranty, so $33,500 is a long way off. Our list for the T45 Utility plus the 3-year extended warranty is $44,400. To get a deal done today, I can offer $42,500 for the pair. That covers 3 years of parts and labor beyond the standard 1-year warranty. If you need delivery and setup within 150 miles, I'm happy to price that in too.
My client's budget is $37,500 all-in. $35,500 for T45 + warranty and we close now.

I appreciate you working to close today. $35,500 is still well below where I can go on the T45 and the 3-year warranty. I can come down meaningfully, to $40,200 for the pair. That's $4,200 off our list, and it includes 3 years of parts and labor coverage beyond the standard warranty. If your client's budget is firm, we could also look at the T45 without the extended warranty, which would bring the total down.
$37,000 for T45 + warranty, paid in full right now.

We're getting close. Your client's budget is $37,500 all-in, so let's meet right at it: $38,900 for the T45 Utility plus the 3-year extended warranty. That's $5,500 off list and includes 3 years of parts and labor beyond the standard warranty. If that has to land at $37,500 exactly, the cleanest route is the T45 on its own, and I can do that today.
$37,500 with the warranty is my final number. Accept and I pay immediately.

I appreciate the firm number and the ready payment. I can't do $37,500 with the warranty, but I can come close: $38,000 for the T45 Utility plus the 3-year extended warranty, payable today. That's $6,400 off list and covers 3 years of parts and labor beyond the standard warranty. If $37,500 is a hard ceiling, I can do the T45 on its own well under that. Just say the word.
Split the difference: $37,700 and it's done.
Deal. $37,700 for the T45 Utility plus the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full at checkout. Thanks for working this through with me, and congratulations to your client on the new tractor.
